llm.summary: This is a disclosed local note and document board; uploaded text can persist in browser storage until the user deletes it.

dimensions.detail: The app runs in the browser, uses localStorage, FileReader, clipboard APIs, and Blob downloads, and no fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, remote script, cookie, worker, or service worker behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a static single-file HTML app plus documentation, with no executable install script, dependency install, network bootstrap, or hidden setup observed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger language is broad, including general note/snippet/archive requests and packaging requests; this could cause invocation for adjacent tasks, but the described capabilities remain visible and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Entries, trash, drafts, folders, and previewable uploaded text files are stored persistently in localStorage; this is disclosed and user-driven, but users should treat it as persistent local storage for potentially sensitive content.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The folder/document repository and DOCX export capabilities are explicitly described in SKILL.md and product-intro.md, and the HTML implements those stated local note, archive, preview, copy, delete, and export features.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a local browser-based note and document board. Do not upload highly sensitive files unless you are comfortable with their text being stored in that browser's localStorage; use the app's delete and clear controls when finished, and prefer a dedicated secure document system for regulated or shared data.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: The folder/document repository is not hidden scope expansion: SKILL.md and product-intro.md both explicitly advertise file folders, uploads/drag-and-drop, metadata, preview/copy/delete, and local archival.
[SDI-2] expected: The FileReader/localStorage behavior is real for text-like files, but it is limited to user-selected uploads, excludes DOC/DOCX body parsing, has delete controls, and is disclosed as localStorage-based local persistence.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The description has broad positive trigger phrases and a generic packaging trigger, which is a scoping weakness, but it does not introduce hidden authority or unsafe automatic execution.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The usage section lacks explicit non-trigger cases, so users should apply it only to local note/document-board creation rather than general writing, translation, OCR, scraping, or cloud collaboration tasks.
